description: This file defines a React component for managing password security settings in the Mattermost admin console, including password length, character requirements, and login attempt limits.

classes.name: PasswordSettings
classes.description: React component for configuring password and login attempt settings in the admin console.

methods.name: getPasswordErrorsMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message key based on password character requirements.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Constructs a partial admin configuration object from the component's state.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state from the provided admin configuration.

methods.name: getSampleErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns a formatted message indicating password error requirements or length constraints.

methods.name: handleBooleanChange
methods.description: Creates a handler to toggle boolean password setting options.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title for the password settings section.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the password settings form including length, character requirements, login attempts, and forgot password link toggle.
